stories.title: Teenager, 17, charged with terrorism offences
stories.summary: The 17-year-old made no plea during an initial appearance at Dundee Sheriff Court on terror charges.

stories.title: Urgent search for vulnerable teenager who is non-verbal
stories.summary: Police Scotland have asked members of the public to check garden sheds and outhouses for the 16-year-old who is missing from Glasgow.

stories.title: Will the 'powerful men' debate change Scotland's sexual consent law?
stories.summary: Scotland's justice secretary says ministers will consider "evidence-based" proposals in the wake of Russell Brand's rape conviction.

stories.title: Nearly 80% of responses to council survey opposed to visitor levy
stories.summary: Council officials raised the possibility of a flat £5 per room/area, per night rate.

stories.title: Miliband says he won't resign if government approves Rosebank oil field
stories.summary: Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh is to make a decision on Britain's largest untapped oil field.

stories.title: Scotcast - Data centres: Why a political reckoning is coming
stories.summary: Thousands have marched along Edinburgh's Royal Mile in protest.

stories.title: Four youths charged in connection with Bonfire Night disorder
stories.summary: Police officers were targeted with fireworks after responding to calls about a street in Edinburgh being blocked.

stories.title: Boy, 15, charged with attempted murder after street stabbing
stories.summary: Emergency services were called to Norham Street in Glasgow last Wednesday.

stories.title: Tourette's film I Swear wins three Scottish Baftas
stories.summary: The film about Tourette syndrome campaigner John Davidson won Best Film, Best Director and Best Actor.

stories.title: I survived a fire that killed my boyfriend - it was started by his brother
stories.summary: Cameron Logan was killed and Rebecca Williams suffered serious injuries after Blair Logan set the bed they were sleeping on alight.

stories.title: Coldest night of autumn so far followed by snow warning
stories.summary: The temperature dipped to -7.7C at Tulloch Bridge in the Highlands overnight with snow now forecast for southern Scotland.

stories.title: Police probe after Queen Victoria pyramid cairn at Balmoral vandalised
stories.summary: Prince Albert's Pyramid was commissioned by Queen Victoria and was completed in 1862.
